study: Neutral stock-ID initialization and ranking-aligned retraining with split validation
authorization: User October29 requested attribution and retraining to seek SR>1.5 consistently, with all seed results retained
history: 2019-2025 training/validation and 2022-2025 repeatedly inspected development scoring; no untouched confirmation
seed_rule: First ten source seeds plus next five from the October20 frozen seed-expansion list; no new seed is selected by return
training: Same THINK+mixer AH+PM and restricted dynamic architectures and train-only inputs; deterministic FP32 CUDA. THINK AdamW lr0.001 wd0.001 batch8, dynamic Adam lr0.0001 wd0 batch1, chronological dates, grad norm1. Fixed12epochs; save every epoch state and validation forecasts.
neutral_initialization: Zero THINK mixer's final stock-specific weight matrix and bias; set both dynamic wavelet node filters to1. Parameters remain trainable and inventories unchanged. This is a declared adaptation, not original numerical regeneration.
objective: Date-balanced Huber on centered predictions versus within-date observed-return z-scores clipped[-3,3], plus0.2 pairwise logistic over unique observed pairs with normalized label gap>=0.1. Only training labels enter gradients; outputs are ranking scores, not calibrated raw return forecasts.
validation: Split existing prior-year validation dates chronologically in half; purge first-half labels crossing the first second-half decision. Use first half only for epoch selection; reserve second half for diagnostics. Both precede test. Existing models/preprocessing data use original chronological train fold, no validation training.
selection: loss minimizes first-half normalized rank objective; rank maximizes mean first-half per-date RankIC minus0.5*SD of four chronological quarter mean RankICs. Earliest exact ties. snapshots averages first-half-selected top3 epochs' percentile ranks within each seed, then applies the same outer seed rank aggregation. initial is epoch0 neutral-initialization control.
ensembles: Eligible-stock percentile ranks per seed, equal average over every fixed group seed, then50:50 THINK/dynamic blend; no seed weighting or exclusion
individual_rule: All15single-seed matched-family pairs, all4checkpoint methods, retain5/cap75, all3cost regimes; diagnostics only, no seed selection
risk: Existing20-session/20% basket volatility target, continuousQQQ hedge capped by cap/unused gross budget/QQQ volatility, inherited close execution/ADV limits/costs/settlements/calendar borrow; no new tuning
goal: Strict base-cost SR>1.5 simultaneously in original_five,new_five,fresh_five,ten_seed,fifteen_seed for a trained checkpoint method. Report every account and seed group even if no recipe passes. Initial and deterministic controls are not qualifying learned-model evidence.
reporting: Asset-level old-portfolio attribution, validation selection/audit separation, per-epoch losses/ranking, selected epochs, all group accounts, costs, exposures, independent accounting replay and fixed goals. Separately report an issuer-consolidated control because the historical winner held bothGOOG/GOOGL.
resume: Resume only from hashed same-run epoch checkpoints with optimizer and CPU/CUDA random states; math/source/input changes require new run, never overwrite completed artifacts
stop: One120-fit/12-epoch/576-account declared study. No outcome-driven parameter expansion or seed filtering, no2026market scores, live trading, messages or automation. Failure to reach1.5 is reported as failure, not hidden. More seeds on spent history are initialization checks, not fresh market validation.
